title: Trade Quarter
wikitext:
[[Image:Trade Quarter.jpg|thumb|Trade Quarter]]
The '''Trade Quarter''' is the central area and hub of trade of the [[Undercity]], located just beyond the lifts to the [[Ruins of Lordaeron]]. The center of the Quarter houses the bank, and most of the shops of the Undercity lie around the bank on a series of levels. All other parts of the city can be reached through this quarter via winding passages into the [[Canals]].

Facilities:
* An [[Innkeeper]]
* A [[Bank]]
* A Horde [[Auction House|auction house]] (outer ring)
* A Bat Handler
* [[Cooking]] trainer
* [[Guildmaster]]
